auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Teamup API key sent in the Teamup-Token header. Request a free key at https://teamup.com/api-keys/request.

actions.name: create_event
actions.description: Create an event in a Teamup calendar.

calendarKey.description: The Teamup calendar key or calendar identifier that addresses the calendar.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone used when Teamup returns event timestamps.

startDateTime.description: The event start timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

endDateTime.description: The event end timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

subcalendarIds.description: The Teamup subcalendar identifiers assigned to the event.

allDay.description: Whether the event lasts all day.

who.description: The people or group associated with the event.

notes.description: The event notes, which may contain Teamup-supported HTML.

recurrenceRule.description: The event recurrence rule accepted by Teamup.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for creating a Teamup event.

event.description: The event object returned by Teamup.

outputSchema.description: The response returned after creating a Teamup event.

actions.name: delete_event
actions.description: Delete an event from a Teamup calendar.

calendarKey.description: The Teamup calendar key or calendar identifier that addresses the calendar.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for deleting a Teamup event.

anyOf.description: The identifier Teamup can use to undo the deletion.

undoId.description: The identifier Teamup can use to undo the deletion.

outputSchema.description: The response returned after deleting a Teamup event.

actions.name: get_event
actions.description: Get one Teamup calendar event by its identifier.

calendarKey.description: The Teamup calendar key or calendar identifier that addresses the calendar.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone used when Teamup returns event timestamps.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for getting a Teamup event.

event.description: The event object returned by Teamup.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when getting a Teamup event.

actions.name: list_events
actions.description: List events from a Teamup calendar over an optional date range.

calendarKey.description: The Teamup calendar key or calendar identifier that addresses the calendar.

startDate.description: The inclusive range start in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The inclusive range end in YYYY-MM-DD format.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone used when Teamup returns event timestamps.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Teamup events.

items.description: The event object returned by Teamup.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when listing Teamup events.

actions.name: list_subcalendars
actions.description: List subcalendars available through a Teamup calendar key or identifier.

calendarKey.description: The Teamup calendar key or calendar identifier that addresses the calendar.

includeInactive.description: Whether inactive subcalendars should be included.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Teamup subcalendars.

items.description: The subcalendar object returned by Teamup.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when listing Teamup subcalendars.

actions.name: update_event
actions.description: Update selected fields of an existing Teamup calendar event.

calendarKey.description: The Teamup calendar key or calendar identifier that addresses the calendar.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone used when Teamup returns event timestamps.

startDateTime.description: The event start timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

endDateTime.description: The event end timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

subcalendarIds.description: The Teamup subcalendar identifiers assigned to the event.

allDay.description: Whether the event lasts all day.

who.description: The people or group associated with the event.

notes.description: The event notes, which may contain Teamup-supported HTML.

recurrenceRule.description: The event recurrence rule accepted by Teamup.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for updating a Teamup event.

event.description: The event object returned by Teamup.

anyOf.description: The identifier Teamup can use to undo the update.

undoId.description: The identifier Teamup can use to undo the update.

outputSchema.description: The response returned after updating a Teamup event.
